scenes.title: The Armani Tuxedo
scenes.summary: At a fitting for Cannes, Juliette Binoche struggles with a sophisticated dress and decides to wear an Armani tuxedo instead.

scenes.title: Holding the Fort
scenes.summary: At the ASK office, Arlette comforts a disappointed client on the phone while Hicham gives instructions to the team staying behind.

scenes.title: Looking After Jean Gabin
scenes.summary: Arlette asks Hervé to take care of her dog, Jean Gabin, while she is away in Cannes.

scenes.title: An Emotional Rollercoaster
scenes.summary: Gabriel talks to a depressed Julien Doré on the phone, telling him to stop reading his screenplay and move on.

scenes.title: A Tight Schedule
scenes.summary: Andréa stresses over Juliette Binoche's schedule and desperately needs an appointment with Chopard.

scenes.title: A Wonderful Showbiz World
scenes.summary: Camille and her mother Annick talk at a hair salon. Annick criticizes Mathias and the agency for letting Camille down.

scenes.title: Sharpens My Appetite
scenes.summary: Hicham and Andréa have dinner. Hicham notices her increased appetite and comments on her changing body, knowing she is pregnant.

scenes.title: The Writer's Pitch
scenes.summary: While holding the fort, Hervé deals with a persistent writer who tries to pitch a crazy screenplay for Isabelle Huppert.

scenes.title: The Tuxedo Problem
scenes.summary: In Cannes, Andréa informs Juliette that she cannot wear the Armani tuxedo because Gong Li is wearing the same one.

scenes.title: The Jewelry Bodyguard
scenes.summary: Andréa meets Renard, the bodyguard in charge of the Chopard jewelry, and eventually gets access to Juliette's room.

scenes.title: Rehearsing the Speech
scenes.summary: Juliette rehearses her opening speech on stage while a technician helps her get used to the earpiece.

scenes.title: Like a Wonderful Flower
scenes.summary: Jean-Denis Gillières spots Juliette and approaches her, expressing his admiration for her blooming beauty.

scenes.title: Lunch on the Boat
scenes.summary: Andréa protects Juliette from Gillières's advances, cleverly arranging a lunch on his boat for a day when Juliette will have already left.

scenes.title: Fully Booked
scenes.summary: Noémie frantically tries to book a train to Cannes to surprise Mathias, but everything is fully booked.

scenes.title: That Child is Mine
scenes.summary: Hicham confronts Andréa at a bar in Cannes, claiming that the child is his and that she doesn't get to decide alone.

scenes.title: Holding the Fort Together
scenes.summary: Hervé complains about picking up dog shit. Noémie breaks down over Mathias and decides to stay in Paris with Hervé.

scenes.title: Diplomatic Skills
scenes.summary: Andréa and Gabriel discuss Hicham's paternity claim. Later, Gabriel warns Andréa about the dangers of humiliating Gillières.

scenes.title: I Can't Love You
scenes.summary: Mathias's wife confronts him about his past and Camille. She tells him she went to Mandelieu and that Camille is in a bad way.

scenes.title: Strolling Around
scenes.summary: Arlette and Gabriel stroll through the streets of Cannes, with Arlette confused by the various festival sections.

scenes.title: Feline Beauty
scenes.summary: Juliette reads a creepy poem sent by Gillières. Andréa tries to manage the situation without upsetting the powerful boss.

scenes.title: The Red Carpet
scenes.summary: Andréa and Hicham arrive at the red carpet. Just as things start, Hicham desperately needs to use the bathroom.

scenes.title: Lost in the Corridors
scenes.summary: Andréa and Hicham get hopelessly lost in the backstage corridors of the Palais while searching for a bathroom.

scenes.title: Intoxicated by Power
scenes.summary: Gillières corners Juliette, intoxicated by her power. The situation is tense just before the ceremony begins.

scenes.title: The Opening Ceremony
scenes.summary: Despite a wardrobe malfunction, Juliette Binoche delivers a brilliant and empowering opening speech at the Cannes Film Festival.

scenes.title: Flip-Flops in Cannes
scenes.summary: Mathias invites Camille to a party in Cannes, offering her a dress and letting her borrow a pair of shoes.

scenes.title: A Serious Offer
scenes.summary: At the party, a UBA executive approaches Andréa with a serious offer to run the agency in New York.

scenes.title: Come to New York
scenes.summary: Andréa reunites with Camille at the party and invites her to come to New York and be her assistant at UBA.

scenes.title: A Fraction of a Second
scenes.summary: Gabriel talks to a depressed Julien Doré, who laments how his film went from possible to impossible in a fraction of a second.

scenes.title: Looking for Sofia
scenes.summary: Gabriel searches frantically for Sofia at the party. Meanwhile, Hicham and Mathias discuss the UBA offer.

scenes.title: I Love You, Andréa
scenes.summary: Gabriel confesses his love to Andréa after Sofia leaves him. Andréa says she loves him too.

scenes.title: In the Pool at Cannes
scenes.summary: Andréa tells Gabriel she is pregnant by Hicham. Mathias and Hicham discuss buying UBA and everyone jumps in the pool.
